about.title: About Koe
about.privacyBody: Koe has no backend. There is no server that can receive your audio or transcript. All processing happens inside your browser using WebAssembly. The only network requests are: loading this site, and downloading the speech model you explicitly choose. No telemetry, no analytics, no cookies, no accounts.
about.offlineBody: After the model is downloaded once, Koe works fully offline. Install it as a PWA for the best experience.
about.unlimitedBody: No quotas, no subscriptions, no per-minute fees. Koe is open source under the MIT license.
about.nameBody: Koe (å£°) means voice in Japanese. It is the lighter sibling of Kikoe, the command line tool.
about.licensesBody: Koe is MIT licensed. It builds on Whisper by OpenAI (MIT), ONNX Runtime Web (MIT), Hugging Face Transformers.js (Apache-2.0), React (MIT), and Tailwind CSS (MIT). Font: Nunito (SIL Open Font License), self-hosted.

help.title: Help
help.browserBody: Latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari on desktop. Android Chrome works with a memory warning. iOS Safari is experimental. Multi-threading needs cross-origin isolation headers, which this site sends.
help.modelBody: Tiny is fastest and smallest. Base is a good default. Small is the most accurate of the three but downloads about 242 MB and needs more memory. When in doubt, start with Base.
help.memoryBody: Audio is decoded fully in memory, so very long files (over 30 minutes) may fail on devices with little memory. Use Tiny, close other tabs, or trim the file first.
help.formatBody: TXT is plain text. SRT and VTT are subtitles with timestamps. JSON contains per-segment timestamps for further processing.
help.privacyBody: No. Nothing is uploaded. You can verify this yourself: open your browser's network tab and watch zero requests while transcribing.
help.troubleBody: Stuck or crashed? Reload the page. If the model fails to load, see the Model failed to load section. The Tiny and Base models are bundled with koe and load locally; only Small downloads. If transcription fails on a long file, try a smaller model.
help.recoverFailedBody: Click the Coba lagi button next to the error. If it keeps failing, clear site data (browser DevTools, Application, Storage, Clear site data), then reload the page. If Base still fails, try Tiny. If the Small model fails to download, check your connection and try again; partial downloads resume from the browser cache.

step1.title: 1. Drop a file
step1.body: Audio or video, up to long recordings. Everything is decoded inside your browser.

step2.title: 2. koe works for you
step2.body: No account, no upload. The model is bundled in koe; the first visit downloads it once, then it is cached.

step3.title: 3. Transcribe
step3.body: Pick a language and press Start. Segments appear as they are recognized.

step4.title: 4. Export
step4.body: Copy to the clipboard, or download TXT, SRT, VTT or JSON. Zip available for multiple files.

firstLoad.q: The first load seems slow. What should I expect?
firstLoad.a: The first visit downloads the bundled model once (about 43 MB for Tiny, 74 MB for Base). After that it is cached and every visit is instant, even offline. On a slow connection the first open can take a minute; subsequent visits are fast.

error.q: The model fails to load. What do I do?
error.a: Click Retry next to the error. If it keeps failing, clear this site data (browser DevTools, Application, Storage, Clear site data) and reload the page. If Base still fails, switch to Tiny. Only the Small model needs a connection; Tiny and Base never do.

offline.a: Yes. Tiny and Base are bundled and work without a network after the first visit. Small downloads once from Hugging Face and then works offline too.

whichModel.a: Tiny is fastest and is the default. Base is more accurate with a somewhat bigger file. Small is the most accurate of the three and downloads on first use. When in doubt, keep Tiny; switch to Base only if the transcript is not good enough.

privacy.a: No. koe has no backend. Audio is decoded and transcribed inside your browser; nothing leaves your device except the model download itself, which never contains your audio.

longFile.q: My file is very long or the tab crashes. What can I do?
longFile.a: Use Tiny, close other tabs, or trim the file first. Audio is decoded fully in memory, so very long files need a lot of RAM. koe warns on devices reporting less than 4 GB of RAM.
